integrationReview.summary: The host adapter was written against the pre-change PCSX2 API but the upstream patch alters multiple interfaces it depends on, so the integration is not consistent with the target revision.
risks: Host::Throttle signature changed to Throttle(bool vsync_start); the adapter/engine callers are not reconciled with this new ABI.

New pure/required symbols were added upstream (GSStartSavingMetrics, GSDumpSavedMetrics, GSIsSavingMetrics, GSToggleVideoCapture, GSResetStats, VMManager::Internal::GetCurrentRegion) that the adapter does not implement or account for.
VMBootParameters gained a game_config field and VMManager now validates game_config, but the adapter never sets it, so the -gamecfg path is inert.

The CU 'UserHacks_RewriteLargeSTCoords' / AdvancedFrameDisplay / DumpReplay* additions are not surfaced through the libretro core options in modern_main.cpp, leaving upstream behavior unreachable from the frontend.
GSDumpReplayer::SetFrameRange/SetLoopCount are now invoked from VMManager; the adapter's GS dump handling is not shown to support these, risking option mismatch.
CMake changes (ARCH_X86 gating of ENABLE_RAINTEGRATION, dxcompiler link, shader baking option) are not reflected in the adapter's build/runtime expectations.
GSCapture::FlushAudioOnly() is called during state load upstream while the adapter stubs the entire GSCapture namespace as no-ops, diverging from the real capture lifecycle.
